scenario_title: Auto Scaling group max size cut
title: Latency and timeouts on cloud-api

detection.alert: cloud-api: p99 latency > 2 s for 5 min

impact: Requests slowed down and a share of them timed out on cloud-api
symptom: [ANOMALY] cloud-api 2026-07-03 10:50-15:30: cloud-api: 458 of 580 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-07-03 10:50 and 2026-07-03 15:30 UTC (peak error ratio 0.91 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 29.638 s vs baseline band up to 0.453 s.
error_templates: Unexpected exception while calling compute-svc: ReadTimeout: Read timed out. (read timeout=2.0)

_templates.macro: Terraform change cut the {svc} Auto Scaling group max_size {old} -> {new}; at the next batch peak the fleet could not scale out and jobs queued.

culprit.diff:
@@ -112,3 +112,3 @@ aws_autoscaling_group.node_svc
 resource "aws_autoscaling_group" "node_svc" {
-  max_size = 12
+  max_size = 6
   tags = local.tags

rca.macro: Terraform change cut the node-svc Auto Scaling group max_size 12 -> 6; at the next batch peak the fleet could not scale out and jobs queued.

action_items: Require a reviewed `terraform plan` and a CloudWatch alarm for the changed AWS resource.
Alert on the error signature `<*> <*> <*> HTTP/1.1" status: <*> len: <*> time: <*>`.
